plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its real-world applications.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its real-world applications.

blocks.title: Mathematical Foundation of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Machine learning relies on mathematical concepts to model and analyze data.
examples: Probability theory, linear algebra, and calculus are foundational for understanding machine learning algorithms.

blocks.title: What is Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the definition of machine learning is essential for grasping its scope and applications.
examples: Machine learning is a field of study that gives computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed.

blocks.title: Real-World Applications of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Seeing how machine learning is used in real-life scenarios helps students appreciate its practical value.
examples: Smart assistants, advertising, and electrical load prediction are key examples of ML applications.

blocks.title: Why Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the motivations behind machine learning helps students grasp its significance in modern technology.
examples: ML is used to solve complex problems that are difficult to address with traditional programming methods.

blocks.title: Big Picture of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: The big picture of machine learning helps students understand its overall structure and purpose.
examples: Taking picking fruits as an example, ML involves learning patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.
